name: bacitracin zinc + polymyxin b
uses: INDICATIONS AND USAGE: Polycin® Ophthalmic Ointment is indicated for the topical treatment of superficial infections of the external eye and its adnexa caused by susceptible bacteria. Such infections encompass conjunctivitis, keratitis and keratoconjunctivitis, blepharitis and blepharoconjunctivitis.
pediatric: Pediatric Use: Safety and effectiveness in pediatric patients have not been established.
contra: CONTRAINDICATIONS: Polycin® Ophthalmic Ointment is contraindicated in individuals who have shown hypersensitivity to any of its components.
